```{python}
from pathlib import Path
from html import escape

svg=['<svg xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" width="1200" height="650" viewBox="0 0 1200 650" role="img" aria-labelledby="title desc">',
     '<title id="title">Una torre moguda: geometries independents o trams derivats</title>',
     '<desc id="desc">La torre T2 canvia de posició. En una capa independent les línies romanen al lloc anterior. Amb extrems referenciats per identificador i una regla de reconstrucció, els trams T1–T2 i T2–T3 acompanyen T2.</desc>',
     '<rect width="1200" height="650" fill="#ffffff"/>',
     '<g font-family="Arial, Liberation Sans, sans-serif" font-size="28" fill="#21313c">']

def text(x,y,s,anchor="start",bold=False):
    svg.append(f'<text x="{x}" y="{y}" text-anchor="{anchor}" font-weight="{700 if bold else 400}">{escape(s)}</text>')

def chain(points,color="#176486",dash=""):
    pts=" ".join(f"{x},{y}" for x,y in points)
    svg.append(f'<polyline points="{pts}" fill="none" stroke="{color}" stroke-width="6" stroke-dasharray="{dash}"/>')

def tower(x,y,name):
    svg.append(f'<circle cx="{x}" cy="{y}" r="12" fill="#e7b65b" stroke="#6c501d" stroke-width="3"/>')
    text(x,y-24,name,"middle")

text(35,42,"Posició inicial",bold=True)
initial={"T1":(340,155),"T2":(600,155),"T3":(860,155)}
edges=[("T1","T2"),("T2","T3")]
chain([initial[k] for k in ("T1","T2","T3")])
for k,(x,y) in initial.items(): tower(x,y,k)
text(470,202,"L1","middle")
text(730,202,"L2","middle")
svg.append('<path d="M600,234 L600,278 M600,278 L585,263 M600,278 L615,263" fill="none" stroke="#71828b" stroke-width="3"/>')
text(628,265,"es mou T2")
svg.append('<line x1="600" y1="320" x2="600" y2="580" stroke="#c5d0d5" stroke-width="2"/>')
text(35,332,"Geometries independents",bold=True)
text(635,332,"Extrems vinculats a les torres",bold=True)
for offset,derived in [(0,False),(600,True)]:
    old={"T1":(offset+90,500),"T2":(offset+300,500),"T3":(offset+510,500)}
    new={**old,"T2":(offset+300,408)}
    if derived:
        chain([old[k] for k in ("T1","T2","T3")],"#acb8bd","7 7")
        for a,b in edges:
            chain([new[a],new[b]])
            assert new[a] != new[b]
    else:
        chain([old[k] for k in ("T1","T2","T3")])
        svg.append(f'<circle cx="{offset+300}" cy="500" r="18" fill="#ffffff" stroke="#b44c3b" stroke-width="4"/>')
    svg.append(f'<path d="M{offset+300},480 L{offset+300},432 M{offset+300},432 l-9,13 m9,-13 l9,13" fill="none" stroke="#b44c3b" stroke-width="3"/>')
    for k,(x,y) in new.items(): tower(x,y,k)
    text(offset+300,557,"trams desconnectats" if not derived else "trams reconstruïts","middle")
text(440,622,"L1 : T1 → T2","middle")
text(760,622,"L2 : T2 → T3","middle")
svg.extend(['</g>','</svg>'])
root=next(p for p in (Path.cwd(),*Path.cwd().parents) if (p/".unaltraweb/computations.yml").is_file())
out=root/"assets/img/generated/03-estructura-formats-referenciacio/tower-network-update.svg"
out.parent.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True)
out.write_text("\n".join(svg)+"\n",encoding="utf-8")
```
